title: Terminal Tips Carousel
description: Command-line styled tips carousel: amber monospace text on a deep navy canvas with a scanline overlay. The cover reads like a boot prompt, each content slide is a numbered listing line with an output block underneath, and the closing slide ends on a prompt with a block cursor.
why_it_works: The terminal frame is instantly legible as code culture, so the right audience self-selects in the first frame. Line numbers act as progress markers that make the swipe feel finite, and the output block enforces one short explanation per slide instead of a wall of text.
content_brief: Write for a technical reader: concrete, no marketing language. boot_command is a fake command line that names the topic, under 30 characters. Keep hook_headline under 60 characters, uppercase reads best. Number the content slides in tens (10, 20, 30) so the listing metaphor holds. tip_title is an imperative under 44 characters; tip_body explains the why in at most two sentences and under 200 characters. Close with a save or follow ask and never use exclamation marks.

slides.layout_note: Cover: accent prompt line at the top, uppercase display-scale headline with a block cursor, supporting line under it, status row pinned to the foot.

slots.name: boot_command
slots.hint: Fake command that names the topic, lowercase with a leading marker.

slots.name: hook_headline
slots.hint: The promise of the list, stated flat.
slots.example: Six deploy habits that stop 3am pages

slots.name: hook_subline
slots.hint: Who the list is for or what changes after reading it.
slots.example: For small teams shipping to production every day.

slides.layout_note: Listing slide: accent line number beside an uppercase tip title, an output label, then the explanation in a rule-marked block.

slots.name: line_number
slots.hint: Listing number in tens, ascending across slides.

slots.name: tip_body
slots.hint: Why it matters, at most two sentences.
slots.example: Merging early keeps branches short and reviews honest. The flag lets you turn the feature on for one account before the whole fleet.

slides.layout_note: Closing slide: prompt line, uppercase ask in display type, accent block button, handle and end cursor on the foot row.

slots.name: cta_message
slots.hint: Save or follow ask tied to the list.
slots.example: Keep this next to your runbook

html_template:
{{boot_command}}

{{hook_headline}}

{{hook_subline}}

LIST 01..NSWIPE >>
RUN
{{line_number}}

{{tip_title}}

output

{{tip_body}}

READY>
READY

{{cta_message}}

{{cta_action}}
{{profile_handle}}END
source_note: Monospace terminal-listing layout pattern observed in a Figma community file; all markup, styling and copy original.
